title: AI Tools: A .NET MAUI Multi-Model Chat Application
description:
AI Tools is a cross-platform mobile application built with .NET MAUI that provides a unified interface for interacting with multiple large language models, including DeepSeek, Doubao and Qwen.

Features:

  • Multi-model chat with seamless switching between DeepSeek, Doubao and Qwen
  • Image attachments (Doubao and Qwen) and text-file attachments (PDF, TXT, JSON) as context
  • Persistent chat history grouped into topics
  • User registration with email verification code, login and profile management (avatar, display name, gender, bio, phone)
  • Model Square: a gallery of 8 popular AI models with specs, capability radar, pricing and reviews

The app targets Android, iOS, macOS (Mac Catalyst) and Windows, and communicates with a Spring Boot backend over REST.
